_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior deck staining/coating. Context prefix DECK — no collision with existing prefixes (CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, MSRY). NOT an NC-only spec — covers new construction AND existing decks via wood_condition dimension. STAIN-based spec — coating_type replaces quality_tier as primary dimension. No primer module for penetrating stains (clear/semi-transparent/semi-solid). Multi-item component-based scope (4 paintable items across 3 UOM types). Composite decking excluded.

paintable_items.name: Deck floor field surface (main walking surface)
paintable_items.notes: New ITM for deck floor field. SF-based — net deck floor area from PaintScope. Primary item. Highest wear surface (horizontal, foot traffic, UV). Production rates vary by coating_type and application_method.

paintable_items.name: Deck railing system (top rail, bottom rail, posts)
paintable_items.notes: New ITM for deck railing system. LF-based — linear feet of railing run. Includes top rail, bottom rail, and posts per linear foot. Activated when scope_components = floor_and_railings or full_deck. Brush application primary method.

paintable_items.name: Deck spindle/baluster (individual vertical member)
paintable_items.notes: New ITM for deck spindles/balusters. EA-based — individually counted and stained. 4 sides + top/bottom per spindle. High labor intensity. Turned spindles slower than square. Activated when scope_components = full_deck. Typical ~3 spindles per LF of railing.

paintable_items.name: Deck stair step (tread + riser per step)
paintable_items.notes: New ITM for deck stair steps. EA-based — each tread+riser is one unit. Includes end-grain sealing and detail brushwork. Alternating step staining pattern for access. Activated when scope_components = full_deck.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF/generic, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, MSRY. DECK is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_DECK_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_DECK_MOISTURE_TEST, TSK_DECK_MILL_GLAZE_REMOVE, TSK_DECK_CHEM_STRIP, TSK_DECK_BRIGHTEN, TSK_DECK_STAIN_FLOOR_BRUSH, TSK_DECK_STAIN_FLOOR_SPRAY_BACKBRUSH, TSK_DECK_STAIN_RAILING_BRUSH, TSK_DECK_STAIN_SPINDLE_BRUSH, TSK_DECK_STAIN_STAIR_BRUSH, TSK_DECK_FURNITURE_STAGE

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — siding masking, landscape below deck, hardscape adjacent, furniture staging, light fixture masking

Floor prep — moisture testing (mandatory all conditions), mill glaze removal (new wood), sanding (weathered/previously coated), power wash (previously coated). Condition-specific task activation via wood_condition dimension.
Railing/spindle/stair prep — sanding, cleaning, end-grain prep. Activated when scope_components includes railings or full_deck.

CONDITIONAL — weathered wood only. Three-step chemical restoration: (1) alkaline strip/clean, (2) acid brighten (oxalic for cedar/redwood), (3) neutralize and rinse. 24-48 hr dry time after. Effectively a separate mobilization day.
Floor field stain application — brush, pad, or spray_backbrush by application_method. 1-2 coats by coating_type. Back-brushing mandatory when spraying penetrating stains.
Railing system stain application — brush primary, spray_backbrush for long runs. Includes spindle staining (individually brushed). Activated when scope_components includes railings.

Stair stain application — brush primary. Alternating step pattern (stain every other step, allow to dry, then remaining steps). Includes end-grain sealing. Activated when scope_components = full_deck.
Protection teardown, furniture return, tool cleaning, final inspection. Solid stain delamination risk documentation (when coating_type = solid_stain on horizontal).

paintscope_keys.description: Net deck floor field area (square feet). Main walking surface.
Linear feet of deck railing run (top rail, bottom rail, posts per LF)
Count of individual deck spindles/balusters. Can be derived from railing LF (~3 per LF) or counted directly.
Count of deck stair steps (each tread+riser = 1 unit)

Primary configuration dimension — coating type (clear_sealer, semi_transparent, semi_solid, solid_stain). Replaces quality_tier for this spec. Drives coating chemistry, failure mode, maintenance cycle, and primer requirement.
Wood condition (new, weathered, previously_coated). Drives prep module selection and prep material requirements.
Deck wood substrate type (pressure_treated_pine, cedar, redwood). Drives seasoning requirements, tannin management, and stain compatibility.
Siding area at deck-to-house junction requiring protection. Plastic sheeting on siding face from deck level up 4-6 ft when spraying.
paintscope_keys.notes: New PS key — PS_EXT_PROTECT_SF.LANDSCAPE_ADJACENT exists but no SIDING_ADJACENT in current registry. Siding protection at ledger board junction is this spec's responsibility.

paintscope_keys.description: Linear feet of deck perimeter where below-deck landscape requires protection (elevated decks).
Adjacent walkway area requiring protection from stain overspray/drip
Count of on-deck furniture groups requiring relocation or covering. Unique to deck scope — items on the surface being stained.
paintscope_keys.notes: New PS key. No equivalent in wall/siding specs. Furniture staging is a protection task unique to decks.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of deck-mounted or railing-mounted light fixtures to mask
Boolean flag for new construction context. Used in combination with wood_condition to determine prep requirements.

coating_type.notes: PRIMARY CONFIGURATION DIMENSION — replaces quality_tier for this spec. Drives coating chemistry (penetrating vs film-forming), maintenance cycle, failure mode profile, and primer requirement. Semi-transparent is the professional standard default. Proposed new enum type for controlled_enums.json.

wood_condition.notes: Drives prep module selection. New: mill glaze removal + seasoning verification. Weathered: chemical restoration protocol. Previously_coated: assess existing coating, strip if failing. Proposed new enum type for controlled_enums.json.

substrate_type.notes: Wood species. PT pine is ~80% of residential decks. Cedar/redwood have tannin management requirements. Composite explicitly excluded. Proposed new enum type for controlled_enums.json.

application_method.notes: Spray-only PROHIBITED for penetrating stains — back-brushing mandatory. spray_backbrush is the deck equivalent of masonry spray_backroll (brush forces stain into wood grain). pad is pad/lamb's wool applicator for floor field. spray_backbrush and pad are proposed additions to controlled_enums.json application_method valid_values.

scope_components.notes: Controls which paintable items are active. floor_only: ITM_DECK_FLOOR. floor_and_railings: adds ITM_DECK_RAILING + ITM_DECK_SPINDLE. full_deck: adds ITM_DECK_STAIR. Similar to cabinet scope pattern. Proposed new enum type for controlled_enums.json.

phase.notes: Simplified phase set — no prime (stains don't use primer), no interstage (penetrating stains absorb, no intercoat sanding), no finish (stain application uses 'apply' phase — it is neither prime nor traditional finish). 'apply' is the correct phase for stain application per controlled_enums: 'Generic coating application (used when phase is not specifically prime or finish)'.

task_classification.notes: binary: same rate all coating types. ct_conditional: task only appears for certain coating types (e.g., chemical restoration for weathered only, tannin primer for solid on cedar). ct_scaled: task rate varies by coating type. Note: 'ct_' prefix proposed for coating_type-driven classification (parallel to qt_ for quality_tier-driven specs).

unit_of_measure.notes: SF for floor field. LF for railings. EA for spindles, stairs, protection items. FIXED for moisture testing, tool cleaning.

substrate_state.notes: All input and output states exist in controlled_enums.json substrate_state valid_values. SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD = new wood. SS_EXT_STAINED_SOLID/SS_EXT_STAINED_SEMI = previously coated. SS_EXT_WEATHERED = UV-degraded. Output: clear/semi-transparent/semi-solid are penetrating (SS_EXT_STAINED_SEMI), solid is film-forming (SS_EXT_STAINED_SOLID).

product_role.notes: stain: penetrating stain products (semi-transparent, semi-solid, solid). sealer: clear wood sealer. prep_chemical: deck cleaner, brightener, stripper. specialty: tannin-blocking primer (solid stain on cedar/redwood edge case only). No 'primer' or 'finish' roles — this is a stain spec.

protection_level.notes: Exterior deck zones. light_mask for brush application. Upgrades to full_cover when spray_backbrush. Simpler protection profile than masonry/siding (fewer adjacent surfaces).

task_type.notes: No 'prime' or 'finish' task types — stain application uses 'apply'. 'detail' for spindle and stair detail work.

surface_ids.notes: deck_floor_field, deck_railing, deck_spindle, deck_stair_step are all proposed — new surface IDs. No existing surface_ids cover deck components. Adjacent surfaces: ext_siding_field is proposed (similar to siding_field but exterior context), ext_door_slab not in registry (door at deck entry — protection owned by door spec), foundation_wall is existing.

zone_ids.notes: Siding at deck-to-house ledger board junction. Protection from stain overspray/drip.
Vegetation/landscape below elevated deck. Conditional on deck_height = elevated.
Adjacent patio/walkway at grade. Reuse existing zone from masonry spec.
On-deck furniture groups requiring relocation or covering. Unique to deck scope.
Deck-mounted or railing-mounted light fixtures. Reuse existing zone.

existing_systems_to_consider: No existing SYS_ entries cover deck staining products. Deck stains are a fundamentally different product class from exterior paints (penetrating vs film-forming).

proposed_systems.name: Clear Wood Sealer for Decks
proposed_systems.notes: Water repellent sealer with no UV pigment. Wood grain fully visible. 12-18 month maintenance cycle. 1-2 coats. Coverage: 200-350 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: Semi-Transparent Penetrating Stain for Decks
proposed_systems.notes: Professional standard. Pigmented penetrating stain — wood grain visible through color. 2-3 year cycle. 2 coats standard. Coverage: 200-300 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: Semi-Solid Penetrating Stain for Decks
proposed_systems.notes: Heavy-pigment penetrating stain. Partially masks grain. 3-4 year cycle. 2 coats standard. Coverage: 200-300 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: Solid Stain (Film-Forming) for Decks
proposed_systems.notes: Film-forming coating — opaque color, complete grain masking. 5-7 year cycle. 2 coats with full dry between. DELAMINATION RISK on horizontal surfaces — mandatory risk documentation. Coverage: 300-400 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: Alkaline Deck Cleaner/Stripper
proposed_systems.notes: Sodium percarbonate or sodium hydroxide-based deck cleaner. Step 1 of 3-step chemical restoration protocol for weathered wood. Removes failed coating residue, mildew, dirt, opens wood pores.

proposed_systems.name: Oxalic Acid Wood Brightener
proposed_systems.notes: Oxalic acid (cedar/redwood tannin) or citric acid (alternative). Step 2 of chemical restoration. Restores natural wood color by dissolving surface tannin deposits and neutralizing alkaline residue. Also used as standalone tannin treatment on new cedar/redwood.

material_system_prefix.notes: 6 material systems total: 4 coating products (one per coating_type) + 2 prep chemicals (weathered wood restoration). NO primer system — penetrating stains do not use primer. Exception: solid stain on cedar/redwood may require tannin-blocking primer — handle as edge case with specialty consumable, not a full material system.

proposed_consumables.name: Stiff Synthetic Bristle Brush 4-6 inch (deck stain back-brushing)
proposed_consumables.notes: Primary back-brushing tool for spray_backbrush method. Stiff synthetic bristle forces stain into wood grain pores. Replace frequently — stain degrades bristles faster than paint.

proposed_consumables.name: Stain Brush 2-3 inch (railing/spindle detail)
proposed_consumables.notes: Detail brush for railing, spindle, and stair staining. Smaller size for control on narrow members.

proposed_consumables.name: Pad/Lamb's Wool Applicator (deck floor stain)
proposed_consumables.notes: Floor field stain applicator. Smooth, even application of penetrating stains. Alternative to brush for floor field.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 515 (deck stain)
proposed_consumables.notes: 0.015 orifice for penetrating stain spray. 10-12 inch pattern. Low pressure (800-1200 PSI) to avoid atomizing stain into overspray.

proposed_consumables.name: Plastic Sheeting 4-6 mil (siding/landscape protection)
proposed_consumables.notes: Siding protection at ledger board, below-deck vegetation protection. 4-6 mil for durability.

proposed_consumables.name: Pin-Type Moisture Meter (field tool, tracked as consumable)
proposed_consumables.notes: Electronic pin-type moisture meter for MC < 15% verification. Reusable tool tracked as consumable for project assignment. Replacement pins are the actual consumable.

proposed_consumables.name: Sandpaper 60 Grit (mill glaze removal)
proposed_consumables.notes: Coarse grit for mechanical mill glaze removal on new wood. 60-80 grit range.

proposed_configurations.description: Single coat — clear sealer. Apply once, allow to penetrate.
proposed_configurations.notes: Some clear sealers specify 2 coats — default to single coat, product-dependent override.

proposed_configurations.description: Two coats wet-on-absorbing — semi-transparent and semi-solid penetrating stains. Apply first coat, let absorb 30-60 min, apply second coat while first is still workable.
proposed_configurations.notes: Penetrating stain 2-coat system. NOT wet-on-wet — allow first coat to absorb into wood before second coat. Back-brush any pooling on second coat. Both coats same day in ideal conditions.

proposed_configurations.description: Two coats with full dry between — solid stain (film-forming). Full dry/cure between coats (4-24 hours product-dependent).
proposed_configurations.notes: Film-forming coating requires full dry between coats. Similar to paint 2-coat system. May require separate day for second coat.

proposed_profiles.description: Clear sealer coverage on deck wood — 200-350 SF/gal. Higher on smooth new wood, lower on rough/weathered.
Semi-transparent penetrating stain coverage — 200-300 SF/gal. Absorption varies by wood porosity and condition.
Semi-solid penetrating stain coverage — 200-300 SF/gal. Heavier pigment load, similar absorption to semi-transparent.
Solid stain (film-forming) coverage — 300-400 SF/gal. Film-forming, less absorption than penetrating stains.
Alkaline deck cleaner/stripper coverage — 100-200 SF/gal for weathered wood restoration.
Oxalic acid brightener coverage — 100-200 SF/gal for tannin treatment and wood color restoration.

cross_spec_coordination.notes: Door protection at deck-to-house entry is NOT this spec's responsibility. Door masking belongs in the door spec. Siding protection at the ledger board junction IS this spec's responsibility (stain overspray/drip contacts siding). No cross-spec flags needed.

existing_modifiers: FAC_EXT_ACCESS — ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50 — applies ONLY to exterior railing face work on elevated decks. Floor staining has NO height modifier.

proposed_modifiers.description: Production rate modifier by coating type (primary dimension)
proposed_modifiers.notes: Semi-transparent is baseline (1.00). Clear sealer is fastest (lowest viscosity, no color matching). Semi-solid slightly slower (heavier pigment). Solid stain slowest (film-forming, more careful application, edge management).

proposed_modifiers.description: Prep time modifier by wood condition
proposed_modifiers.notes: New wood is baseline. Weathered adds chemical restoration protocol (significant prep overhead + separate mobilization day). Previously_coated has highest prep overhead (assess, strip if failing, sand, clean). Modifiers apply to PREP tasks only — stain application rate is not affected by wood condition (wood is prepped to consistent state before staining).

proposed_modifiers.description: Production rate modifier by wood species
proposed_modifiers.notes: PT pine is baseline. Cedar/redwood require additional care — tannin management, softer wood (dent risk), end-grain absorption control.

materials_json.stain_spec_note: Material systems branch by coating_type (not quality_tier). Product roles: stain, sealer, prep_chemical (not primer, finish). No oil-based vs water-based distinction at system level — handle as product variant within system.

production_json.stain_spec_note: Production rates vary by coating_type instead of quality_tier. Use rates_by_coating_type instead of rates_by_tier.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ coating_type MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions (coating_type replaces quality_tier for this spec)
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup → prep → apply → cleanup (simplified — no prime, no interstage, no finish for stain spec)
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_DECK_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: All 4 ITM_ IDs (ITM_DECK_FLOOR, ITM_DECK_RAILING, ITM_DECK_SPINDLE, ITM_DECK_STAIR) MUST be used exactly as registered (all proposed)
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Deck Staining/Coating (PT Pine, Cedar, Redwood — New and Existing)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for exterior deck staining. Distinct product system (penetrating stains, not paint), unique dimensional model (coating_type replaces quality_tier), component-based multi-item scope (4 items, 3 UOM types), no primer pipeline, covers both new construction and existing decks.

registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing ITM covers deck railing systems. LF-based — distinct from any existing EA or SF item.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Deck spindle/baluster (individual vertical member)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing ITM covers deck spindles. EA-based individual counting. Distinct from railing LF measurement.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Deck stair step (tread + riser per step)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing ITM covers exterior deck stair steps. Distinct from interior stair_riser (EA) and stair_stringer (LF) — deck stairs are combined tread+riser per step.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Deck floor field surface (horizontal walking surface)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing surface_id covers horizontal deck surfaces. New vocabulary entry.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Wood Condition Enum
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New enum type for controlled_enums.json. Values: new, weathered, previously_coated. Drives prep module selection. substrate_state covers the coating state on the surface; wood_condition covers the physical condition of the wood substrate itself.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Deck Wood Substrate Type Enum
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New enum type. Values: pressure_treated_pine, cedar, redwood. Species-specific prep and stain compatibility requirements.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Deck Scope Components Enum
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New enum type. Values: floor_only, floor_and_railings, full_deck. Controls paintable item activation. Similar pattern to cabinet scope dimension.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Spray with mandatory back-brushing (deck stain penetration)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New value for existing application_method enum. Deck stain spray requires brush back-working (not roller). Distinct from spray_backroll (masonry/siding) — different tool and technique for different substrate physics.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Pad/lamb's wool applicator (deck floor stain)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New value for existing application_method enum. Common deck staining tool for floor field. Provides smooth, even application of penetrating stains.
